authorInfo.bio: Thomas Hughes (1822–1896) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Memoir of a Brother" by Thomas Hughes is a heartfelt memoir written in the late 19th century. The book reflects on the life of the author's brother, focusing on the values of humility, virtue, and the quiet strength embodied by many English men of their time.
